attr.title: Cuphead
attr.desc: A classic run and gun action game heavily focused on boss battles, inspired by 1930s cartoons.
attr.inst: Requires Cuphead for macOS from GOG (1.3.4, with or without The Delicious Last Course): copy GOG's macOS installers (.pkg) or the installed Cuphead.app into ports/cuphead/gamedata. The first launch builds the game on the handheld: one to a few hours, about 10 GB free space during setup, Wi-Fi to download Unity's Android player (about 190 MB). Firmwares without 32-bit support get a 64-bit build, whose setup takes several hours longer (about 12 GB free).
